alias_map.why: One word covered four different situations: a file nobody had found, a file the connector could name, a file on local disk, and a file whose content had been read. A queue built on it cannot answer which units could be worked on this afternoon, which is the only question the queue exists to answer.

headline.name: IMMEDIATELY_EXECUTABLE_UNITS
excludes: units whose source is only located by a connector
candidate structures with no frozen boundary
anything whose binary is not readable in this environment
headline.note: A located record is not an executable unit. That distinction is the whole reason for the state list.

derivation: v5 = the run2 engine with its K2 model advanced to the binary-measured 4.2F-F model; K2 rows read back from the emitted artifacts, non-K2 rows regenerated from source and proven identical to the pre-advance baseline. Counts are the engine's own. Member rolls and four invariant families (partition, uniqueness, state-monotonicity, authority) are machine-checked before publishing. Reproducibility scope: this queue reproduces from the committed Stage-F artifacts alone, without the retired PRODUCTION_QUEUE_v4 and without re-reading the binary; only regenerating the raw extraction evidence from scratch requires the verified K2 binary supplied locally at '.source-intake/K2/2. PENGURUSAN PEMBINAAN LANDASAN.pdf'.
